subject: Proposal: Hosted commit ladder + onboarding timeline for Renewal
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@retailone.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: RetailOne Procurement <procurement@retailone.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + commit increase questions

Hi Mina —

Thanks again for the renewal touchpoint last week. We ran the dashboard with marketing’s new personalization rollout and saw sustained bursts that will push us well past our current hosted 500M token commit in April.

We’re interested in a structured commit increase and want to understand three things before we loop procurement:

- A staged commit ladder (how we can ramp from 500M -> ~1B/month over the next quarter)
- What soft-throttle / burst cushion you can provide during promotional spikes (weekends and product drops)
- Pricing and invoice cadence for a mid-year amendment (contract term extension vs. addendum)

I attached last 6 months of token spend so you can see the distribution. Ideal target: higher predictability for us with a modest discount in return for a larger committed minimum.

Can you share a short proposal this week? We’d like to present to Procurement by Friday.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Product Ops, RetailOne
samira@retailone.com

Attachments: RetailOne_Spend_Monthly.csv (CSV, 120KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@retailone.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 13:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + commit increase questions

Hi Samira —

Thanks for the spend file — that helps a lot. I drafted a short ladder and an operational playbook for handling spikes; attaching the PDF (Proposed_Tier_Ladder_v1.pdf). High level proposal:

1) Commit ladder (6-month amendment):
   - Months 1-2: 700M token commit / month (to cover immediate uplift)
   - Month 3 onwards: 1.0B token commit / month
   - 10% unit discount on committed usage vs. current list for the increased tiers
2) Burst cushion: 20% monthly burst allowance (no surcharge) plus soft-throttle window beyond that where requests are deprioritized but queued for 1–2 minutes (configurable).
3) Onboarding & ops: 2-week technical kickoff with SE (Karthik) to size batching/kv-cache tweaks + a single test day to validate tail-latency before go-live.
4) Invoicing: monthly invoices; prorated first month depending on effective amendment date.

Next steps I propose:
- Internal sizing call with Karthik this Wed (30m)
- We send a one-page amendment (Aditya to draft)
- Procurement review by Friday

@Aditya — can you draft a concise amendment and draft the DocuSign flow?
@Karthik — can you confirm SE availability for Wed and the key technical checklist?

Samira — if that ladder looks directionally correct I’ll prioritize the amendment and get Aditya involved on the contract side.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0182

Attachments: Proposed_Tier_Ladder_v1.pdf (PDF, 90KB)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + commit increase questions — amendment + pricing math

Thanks Mina — quick internal note with numbers so we’re aligned before I send anything to Procurement.

Assumptions pulled from CSV: current avg = 420M/month, peak windows push to ~1.3B in promotional months. Proposal math:
- Current list unit: $0.000015/token (hosted list)
- Proposed committed unit: $0.0000135/token (10% discount on increased tier)
- Estimated committed spend at 1B: $13,500/month in unit charges (plus any add-ons)
- We’ll offer a 20% burst cushion (~200M tokens) that does not consume invoiceable committed usage and does not require immediate extra billing — bursts beyond that will be billed at list but can be capped by contract.

Ops notes for Karthik:
- Recommend continuous prefix caching for personalization templates to reduce per-token cost in the 30–60% category where requests repeat.
- Batching window of 15–25ms for service endpoints A/B (marketing + recommendations) — keep end-to-end p95 < 220ms.
- We should include a canary rollback plan: keep previous 2-week workload traffic routeable to old commit pool for 72 hours after activation.

@Karthik — I put a placeholder amendment in the drive: Commit_Ladder_Calc.xlsx. Can you review technical calls and confirm we can hit p95 targets in test day?

I’ll draft a one-page amendment and a DocuSign envelope after we confirm dates. Sending to Samira Friday if all good.

- Aditya
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Attachments: Commit_Ladder_Calc.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)

Mina / Aditya —

This looks good and aligns with what Procurement will need. A couple of items before we sign:

1) Can we make the month-1 commit apply retroactively to the date the amendment is executed (prorated) — Procurement prefers no gap.
2) Please include a clause that limits surcharge billing during the first quarter after ramp (we want a 30-day mutual review before surcharges are assessed).
3) Confirm start date options — we’d prefer Mar 15 if SE validation is green.

If you can send a one-page amendment + DocuSign link, Procurement will review and should be able to sign within 48 hours. I’m looping them here for visibility.

Samira Khan
